people.name: Benjamin
people.line: Youngest son of Jacob and Rachel

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Samuel
people.line: Prophet and last judge of Israel before the kings

translations.web: So Samuel brought all the tribes of Israel near, and the tribe of Benjamin was chosen.
translations.bsb: Thus Samuel had all the tribes of Israel come forward, and the tribe of Benjamin was selected.
translations.kjv: And when Samuel had caused all the tribes of Israel to come near, the tribe of Benjamin was taken.
translations.asv: So Samuel brought all the tribes of Israel near, and the tribe of Benjamin was taken.
